coupling_convention: dimensionless d_g (scalar coupling to baryon/nucleon mass)
notes: Paper derives constraints on scalar dark matter coupling coefficients d_i from equivalence principle tests (Eöt-Wash torsion balance, MICROSCOPE space mission, atomic clock comparisons). The coupling_type is ScalarBaryon because the paper constrains the coupling of a light scalar field to baryonic matter through tests of the universality of free fall and equivalence principle violations. Two cases studied: (1) linear coupling d^(1)_i and (2) quadratic coupling d^(2)_i. Data points are approximate representative bounds extracted from Figures 3 and 4 (MRA limits at 95% CL) for the linear case, spanning the mass range 10^-24 to ~1 eV where the scalar field behaves classically. The quadratic case shows richer phenomenology with screening/amplification mechanisms. Extraction confidence is moderate (0.65) because: (1) the paper presents multiple coupling coefficients (d_e, d_g, d_m, etc.) with different constraints, (2) the MRA method varies parameters one-at-a-time making it difficult to extract precise numerical bounds from figures, and (3) the paper focuses on theoretical framework and phenomenology rather than presenting a single clean exclusion limit.
